section: CITY OF METROPOLIS - REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL
text:
CITY OF METROPOLIS - REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL
Solicitation Number: CIT-2024-9988
Title: Municipal Mobile Workstation Refresh 2024
Agency: Metropolis Department of Information Technology
1. PROPOSAL SUBMISSION SCHEDULE:
Proposals are due on November 15, 2024 at 3:00 PM EST.
Submission Type: Electronic submission via City Procurement Portal.
2. SCOPE OF WORK & HARDWARE REQUIREMENTS:
The City requires 150 rugged enterprise laptops for field engineers.
Proposed Model: Lenovo ThinkPad P16 Gen 2 or Dell Precision 5680.
Term of Contract: Three (3) year master agreement with two optional 1-year renewals.
Delivery: Within 30 days following notice of award.
Contact Person: procurement@metropolis.gov | Phone: 555-019-2834

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS - CIT-2024-9988
Product Name: Mobile Engineering Workstation
Processor: Intel Core i7-13850HX vPro Processor
RAM: 32 GB DDR5 5600MHz
Storage: 1 TB PCIe NVMe SSD
Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2000 Ada Generation 8GB GDDR6
Warranty: 3-Year Premier Support Plus with Keep Your Hard Drive

Status: Open
Agency: Metropolis Department of Information Technology
Description: Mobile Workstation Refresh for Municipal Field Engineers
